When this card corrects `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`'s "SMS text customisation & localisation" paragraph (the stale seed sentence), it also states what PR #24930 (#24865) made true:
- the OTP and invitation SMS bodies read a `sys_notification_template` row in the organization the send resolves to, `tenancy.defaultOrgId()`;
- under `single`, that is the Default Organization's row;
- under `isolated` and `group`, no row is read and the built-in text is sent.

The paragraph today calls the bodies "tenant-customisable", which is no longer true under a walled posture. Recorded in the seat's REWORK `6296720561` on PR #24930. `Blocked-by: #24865` stands.

- `TEMPLATE_CHANNELS`, the corrected object copy and the `authentication.mdx` paragraph stay.
- The pins and their ablation move to the warning. The changeset and the `Clause-②:` line are re-derived from what then ships.
- The seat files the 19.0 refusal card when the 18.x half lands.
